description: Receipt files and the depth rule (review of the audit 33f3b9f fixes, defect 8): a receipt file is one JSON value read by the ledger text contract, so LEDGER_TEXT.max_depth applies to it too, counted on the whole file's text. For each file: whether it is a readable receipt. imd-flop/test/review-audit2.test.ts (receipt-store.ts listReceipts) and viewer/test_review_audit2.py (build-lane.py read_receipts) read every file here.

depth-32.json.note: 32 levels, the receipt object included: at the limit, readable

depth-33.json.note: 33 levels: over the limit, unreadable in both parts

depth-10000.json.note: 10000 levels: JSON.parse reads it and Python's json does not, so the limit keeps the parts together
